text:
Tia (AE): Heads-up — Nebula Health just asked for an executive-level signoff. They want a dedicated capacity trial, BYO-KMS, and a nonstandard discount. CISO also pinged a SOC2 scoping Q. Need an internal unblock before EOD. @Ava can you weigh in on discount runway?

Devin (SE): I ran a quick perf estimate for their dataset: 4k tokens avg, steady 80 rps for 2 weeks. Dedicated pool we planned (4xA100 equiv) should cover it, but BYO-KMS needs egress/handshake doc. I can attach the draft config.

Maya (Pricing): Discount ask is 40% on hosted usage + waive onboarding. That's outside standard bracket. What commit do they propose? If it's a 12mo $X commit we might do 20-25% + 90-day trial.

Tia (AE): They floated a 9mo committed spend but want flexibility on ramp. They said legal needs the trial in writing for exec signoff.

Sam (Legal): For BYO-KMS we need key import/export flow, attestations, and that the customer understands we don't have key access. I'll need the KMS integration doc and the network topology. Also need to confirm if any logs will contain plaintext PII during processing — that changes contract language.

Leo (SRE): If we're doing dedicated for a POC we should run it in a VPC peering setup. Ops checklist: 1) allowlist Nebula subnets 2) KMS TLS mutual auth 3) throughput test window 4) fallback to hosted model in case of infra fault. Devin, can you run the KV cache perf test and post results?

Devin (SE): Pasted the config snippet below (will share full gdoc):
```
model: redwood-4x-large
pool: dedicated-nebula-1
instances: 4
kms: customer-kms://projects/nebula/keys/alpha
network: vpc-peering
```
Devin (SE): KV cache looks fine in sim — latency median 42ms, p95 120ms with 80rps. I'll attach raw logs to the doc.

Maya (Pricing): @Ava if we push 25% + 60-day trial + milestone-based ramp (month 1 20% commit, month 2 50%, rest steady), we could keep margin. Also propose a one-time onboarding fee to cover ops run.

Ava (CRO): I can greenlight 25% + onboarding fee. If Legal (Sam) signs off on liability for BYO-KMS and Ops gets a runbook, we can escalate to exec for approval. Tia, get Nebula to sign the trial MOU and confirm the commit cadence.

Sam (Legal): Draft MOU ask: 1) scope/timebox (60 days) 2) trial SLA excluded 3) BYO-KMS attestation clause 4) data handling & logs clause. I'll start a skeleton and loop in privacy.

Tia (AE): Great — I'll ping Nebula for MOU template confirmation and loop them into a call tomorrow. Devin, can you drop the perf artifacts into the shared folder by 10:30 PT? OpsBot, can you open a runbook ticket for dedicated-nebula-1? :pray:

OpsBot: Created ticket INF-4829 — "dedicated-nebula-1 runbook + KMS checklist" assigned to Leo. ETA 48h.

Leo (SRE): ACKed INF-4829. I'll draft the runbook and add disaster fallback steps.

Tia (AE): Status: waiting on MOU from Nebula and perf artifacts. If both land today I will ask @Ava for exec signoff. Will update thread. :white_check_mark:
